title: skills: teach sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead in the controlled_by_parent authoring guidance
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Skills-docs follow-up of #33250 (PR #33369, `Metadata-protocol: added`, body line `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/** (the controlled_by_parent authoring guidance)`). Filed before ACCEPT under the review checklist's owed-card rule.

**Gap:** the shipped skills teach the master-edit rule and `ownerMayEdit` only. Files that name `controlled_by_parent` on `main`: `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`.

**TO:** where the skills say a detail write needs edit on the master, add: a `controlled_by_parent` detail may declare `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead: true`; then anyone who can READ the master writes (insert, update, delete) under the detail's own object permission, RLS and FLS. Not with `ownerMayEdit: true` (refused; the new key already admits the owner), and only on a `controlled_by_parent` object (refused elsewhere). Default unchanged. Note the lint arm `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` stays silent on a detail that declares the key. Add one eval prompt if the skill's eval set covers the master-edit rule.

Depends on #33369 merging (the key must parse on `main` before a skill teaches it; `check:skill-examples`). Tier H (`skills/**`): the PR needs the maintainer's approval.
